definition: חָדֵל adjective forbearing, lacking , הֶחָדֵל as substantive Ezek 3:27 he that forbeareth (opposed to שׁמע , compare חָדֵל Qal near the end); construct חֲדַל אִישִׁים Isa 53:3 lacking men (i.e. forsaken by them); — ceasing, transient מֶהחָֿדֵל אָ֑נִי Ps 39:5 , but read rather חֶלֶד see Che critical note .
